A '''city''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[N'dian]]. It was almost completely [[Battle of N'dian|destroyed]] single-handedly by the [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando|Advanced Recon Commando]] [[Ordo Skirata]] during the first [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|364|N'dian}}</ref>
